meta.description: Source-controlled inference burden inventory for moving repeatable Achiote prompt work into deterministic data, retrieval, controller, validation, formatting, observability, and consent layers while preserving smart-model latitude.

provenance.source: Repository architecture review after quality-signal and reference-pantry hardening
notes: This is a planning and governance artifact, not an answer script.
Entries describe where to reduce prompt load without removing model synthesis.

burdens.title: Normalize food and drink names before synthesis
burdens.currentModelBurden: Infer whether misspellings, soundalikes, aliases, and beverage names point to the same memory target.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Expand the alias, transliteration, phonetic, weak-model typo, family nickname, and brand-category registry as typed data.
acceptanceSignals: alias resolution improves without changing final answer templates
misspellings produce visible correction receipts
preserveLatitude: Model may still rank multiple plausible families
Model should explain uncertainty when name evidence is weak
modelKeeps: interpret ambiguous family names
explain why a correction matters
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: A hard alias match could erase regional or family-specific meanings that use the same word differently.

burdens.title: Classify the user request into workflow intent
burdens.currentModelBurden: Decide whether the user wants identification, cue generation, substitution, recipe handoff, sourcing, beverage reconstruction, or clarification.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Represent request intent as a bounded classifier result with evidence, confidence, and allowed next moves.
acceptanceSignals: dietary substitution only fires on explicit adaptation
minimum cue requests do not become full recipes
preserveLatitude: Model may ask for clarification on mixed intents
Model may preserve a secondary intent as a follow-up suggestion
modelKeeps: reason about mixed or emotionally loaded intent
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: A single forced intent can make Achiote feel mechanical when the user is both remembering and asking for adaptation.

burdens.title: Build a compact case file instead of a large prompt
burdens.currentModelBurden: Hold the whole conversation, tool outputs, evidence classes, rules, and output contract in working memory.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Assemble a bounded case file with userSaid, inferred, researched, unknown, retrieved references, constraints, allowed actions, and current step.
acceptanceSignals: prompt token budget drops
receipts retain all evidence classes
weak models stop losing latest corrections
preserveLatitude: Model may still choose the best narrative order
Model may surface a surprising but evidence-bounded hypothesis
modelKeeps: synthesize the case file into humane prose
interpret emotional salience
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Over-compression can remove the sensory texture that lets a strong model make a better cultural inference.

burdens.title: Retrieve pantry and cache context before asking the model
burdens.currentModelBurden: Recall common dish and drink families, culture-area vocabulary, and broad mechanism context from general knowledge.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Use bundled pantry fixtures plus optional SQLite cache records as the first context source for family, region, and mechanism grounding.
acceptanceSignals: cache misses become bounded known gaps
pantry context appears as researched not family-confirmed evidence
preserveLatitude: Model may reject retrieved context when user evidence conflicts
Model may combine multiple retrieved families as hypotheses
modelKeeps: rank retrieved context against the user's actual memory
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Reference records can flatten living family variation if treated as final truth.

burdens.title: Control tool sequence with explicit state transitions
burdens.currentModelBurden: Remember which tool must run next and avoid loops, skipped dependencies, and premature recipe tools.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Move required steps, allowed tool transitions, loop limits, and recovery policies into a state-machine contract.
acceptanceSignals: models can stall without losing the workflow
duplicate tool calls are filtered input-aware
preserveLatitude: Model may decide when enough evidence exists inside allowed states
Model may propose clarification instead of forcing a cue
modelKeeps: reason about sufficiency of current evidence
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: A strict state machine can force a cue for a memory that needs one more human question.

burdens.title: Maintain evidence classes outside model prose
burdens.currentModelBurden: Remember which facts were user-said, inferred, researched, unknown, or family-confirmed.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Keep evidence classes as structured ledger data and render them deterministically into receipts.
acceptanceSignals: final prose cannot silently promote inference to fact
receipt sections remain stable across providers
preserveLatitude: Model may explain how evidence connects
Model may identify which unknown matters most
modelKeeps: synthesize evidence into an understandable trail
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: A ledger without explanation can feel sterile and miss why a clue matters to the family memory.

burdens.title: Apply provider-neutral trust and safety boundaries deterministically
burdens.currentModelBurden: Avoid backend/provider identity leakage, browsing claims, credential echoes, and medical or legal claims.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Represent redaction, allowlist, and claim-policy rules as named validators with metadata in the response path.
acceptanceSignals: public traces stay provider-neutral
medical and legal claims are scrubbed or reframed
preserveLatitude: Model may still discuss food safety as a hypothesis
Model may suggest verifying ingredients independently
modelKeeps: explain boundaries without sounding evasive
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Overzealous redaction can remove useful food-safety caveats or make answers feel broken.

burdens.title: Render stable user-facing sections from structured payloads
burdens.currentModelBurden: Format every answer with the right sections, sequence, labels, and follow-up question structure.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Use typed output schemas and deterministic formatters for receipts, cue cards, family questions, and next-step summaries.
acceptanceSignals: Memory Receipt labels do not drift
minimum cue appears before recipe handoff
preserveLatitude: Model may choose the warm wording inside each section
Model may adapt explanation length to the user
modelKeeps: write concise humane prose
explain why the next step matters
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: A fully templated answer can feel like a form and lose the emotional value of the memory.

burdens.title: Measure weak-model quality failures as bounded signals
burdens.currentModelBurden: Self-diagnose whether its answer was generic, stalled, premature, culturally flattened, or missing a key clue.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Convert post-run behavior into aggregate quality counters and reference seed priorities without storing private text.
acceptanceSignals: operator report shows high-value gaps
seed priorities do not expose user text
preserveLatitude: Model may still recover creatively within a guarded answer
Operator can choose which gaps deserve data work
modelKeeps: reason about answer strategy from current evidence
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Quality scoring should not punish unusual but valid cultural memories just because they do not fit current buckets.

burdens.title: Supply reusable food-science mechanism scaffolds
burdens.currentModelBurden: Remember mechanism vocabulary for aroma, texture, starch, fat, Maillard, fermentation, sweetness, carbonation, and serving temperature.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Use sourced mechanism profiles and cue-building primitives so the model reasons from food-science parts rather than recall.
acceptanceSignals: minimum cues explain mechanism and substitute logic
beverages get extraction, dilution, carbonation, and serving-temperature handling
preserveLatitude: Model may combine mechanisms in unexpected but plausible ways
Model may choose which mechanism is most emotionally salient
modelKeeps: interpret the sensory center of the memory
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Mechanism lists can become cookbook logic if they replace the user's sensory story.

burdens.title: Resolve local availability and substitution candidates before prose
burdens.currentModelBurden: Guess what is available near the user and which substitute plays the same sensory role.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Match location and ingredient signals to regional corridors, store categories, substitute groups, and sensory roles.
acceptanceSignals: sourcing copy remains static guidance not inventory
substitutes carry sensory reasons
preserveLatitude: Model may warn that local availability is uncertain
Model may offer multiple substitute strategies
modelKeeps: explain tradeoffs between exactness and accessibility
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Static availability can become misleading if framed as real-time store knowledge.

burdens.title: Gate optional learning signals outside the model
burdens.currentModelBurden: Remember privacy promises and avoid treating optional improvement data as always available.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Use explicit consent parsing and UI controls to decide whether analytics or quality signals can be recorded.
acceptanceSignals: /ask works when every optional toggle is off
operator reports omit quality signals without opt-in
preserveLatitude: Model may still answer with current request context
User can decide later to share optional learning signals
modelKeeps: reason normally without relying on optional stored data
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Consent gates should not make opted-out users feel punished or receive a worse reconstruction path.

burdens.title: Externalize prompt templates into versioned contracts
burdens.currentModelBurden: Parse repeated natural-language instructions embedded directly inside tool implementations.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Split prompt templates from runtime code and feed them structured constraints, inputs, and output schemas.
acceptanceSignals: tool prompts become shorter and versioned
prompt injection boundaries remain explicit
preserveLatitude: Model may still choose the best wording within a template
Tool authors can tune templates by task
modelKeeps: interpret structured tool context
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Templates that over-prescribe prose can make all tools sound identical and reduce useful adaptation.

burdens.title: Normalize tool-call aliases and weak-model typos from data
burdens.currentModelBurden: Produce exact tool names even when local or weak models drift on spelling.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Move tool alias and typo normalization into a declarative registry with known canonical names and repair reasons.
acceptanceSignals: known weak-model tool typos repair deterministically
unknown tool names remain rejected
preserveLatitude: Model may still decide which valid tool to call
Repair metadata can be shown to operators
modelKeeps: reason about the appropriate canonical tool
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: A broad alias table could accidentally map an invalid or unsafe tool request to a valid action.

burdens.title: Make final-answer sanitizers declarative and auditable
burdens.currentModelBurden: Avoid concrete recipe measurements, premature candidates, generic filler, and unsupported claims in final text.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Create named final-answer validators for recipe leakage, generic text, unsupported claims, provider identity, and clarification needs.
acceptanceSignals: guard reasons are machine-readable
sanitizers are regression-covered by failure mode
preserveLatitude: Model may still write a vivid cue after validation
Model may choose a better clarification question
modelKeeps: explain and rewrite within the validated boundary
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Sanitizers can erase useful specificity if they treat all quantities or concrete nouns as recipe leakage.

burdens.title: Represent provider and model capabilities as validated profiles
burdens.currentModelBurden: Compensate at runtime for context limits, tool-call quirks, final synthesis stalls, and compatibility differences.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Model provider capability, context size, tool strictness, retry budget, and synthesis timeout as explicit profiles.
acceptanceSignals: small models get smaller case files
smart models retain richer optional context
preserveLatitude: Model capability can choose wider or narrower context
Operators can tune profiles per deployment
modelKeeps: synthesize extra context when the profile permits it
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: One static profile can underfeed stronger models or overfeed weaker models.

burdens.title: Treat soft cultural memory patterns as retrieval context
burdens.currentModelBurden: Remember diaspora taste drift, old formulation memories, brand/category substitutions, pandemic supply changes, ritual context, and family nicknames.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Add sourced or semi-formal pattern records for cultural memory signals that guide questions without pretending to be facts.
acceptanceSignals: diaspora and time-drift cases trigger better questions
soft signals stay marked as context not proof
preserveLatitude: Model may decide which pattern actually fits the user's memory
Model may ask a culturally sensitive follow-up before applying a pattern
modelKeeps: interpret lived cultural context with humility
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Soft cultural patterns can become stereotypes if converted into hard rules.

burdens.title: Keep beverage mechanisms first-class
burdens.currentModelBurden: Translate drink memories into extraction, dilution, carbonation, sweetness, dairy body, serving temperature, and aroma-carrying logic.
burdens.dataEngineeringMove: Represent beverage forms and mechanisms as data equal to dishes, not edge cases inside generic food prompts.
acceptanceSignals: drink examples produce sip cues instead of food cues
beverage quality gaps appear in operator report
preserveLatitude: Model may choose whether memory is drink, porridge, sauce, or dessert
Model may preserve family ambiguity around format
modelKeeps: interpret boundary cases between drink and food
burdens.riskIfOverRigid: Some cultures do not separate food and drink categories the way the app does.
